verdict.rationale: ReadMe's docs show an 'Ask AI' feature for instant answers from published documentation, and a runtime probe found that llms.txt queries return a ranked 'Search Results' list, indicating some relevance-ranked search exists out of the box. However, there is no evidence addressing typo-tolerance or search speed/quality benchmarks, and 'Ask AI' is framed as AI Q&A rather than a classic search index. Missing for 10: explicit typo-tolerant search documentation, performance/speed claims, and independent confirmation of search quality across a full docs site.
